composites.name: stage1_composite
composites.description: Stage 1 — staged protocol (assemble → relax → stretch FROZEN → hold elastic → hold viscous). Separates a reproducible elastic modulus from a crosslink-turnover remodelling time.

n_rods.description: Number of two-bead collagen IV rods.

box_xy.description: In-plane box size (units of the bead spacing a).

bending_k.description: Junction bending stiffness (0 = floppy central-force network).

composites.name: stage2_sweep
composites.description: Stage 2 / R2 — growth rheology: the collagen IV network on a growing (biaxially stretching) substrate with the crosslink chemistry ON during the stretch; the σ(ε̇) sweep runs this at a range of strain rates.

n_rods.description: Number of two-bead collagen IV rods.

box_xy.description: In-plane box size (units of the bead spacing a).

bending_k.description: Junction bending stiffness (0 = floppy central-force network).

composites.name: connectivity_sweep
composites.description: Rigidity (bm-v3, adversarial) — the CENTRAL-FORCE counterfactual: bending_k forced to 0, crosslink connectivity (z) swept to test rigidity percolation. A control that should NOT reproduce the released angle-stabilized model.

n_rods.description: Number of two-bead collagen IV rods.

box_xy.description: In-plane box size (units of the bead spacing a).

bending_k.description: Junction bending stiffness (0 = floppy central-force network).

composites.name: bending_sweep
composites.description: FP1 (bm-v4) — the collagen IV network WITH junction bending (released NC1 value, as-formed angle restraints created during assembly). The athermal modulus is swept vs bending_k.

n_rods.description: Number of two-bead collagen IV rods.

box_xy.description: In-plane box size (units of the bead spacing a).

bending_k.description: Junction bending stiffness (fix restrain, as-formed angles); >0 rigidifies.

composites.name: porosity_bundling
composites.description: Stage 5 (bm-v5) — the assembled collagen IV network read for its geometric readouts (pore-size distribution, protomers-per-strand) against the measured BM comparators; emits the assembly observables, not the stress trace.

n_rods.description: Number of two-bead collagen IV rods.

box_xy.description: In-plane box size (units of the bead spacing a).

bending_k.description: Junction bending stiffness (0 = floppy central-force network).

composites.name: actomyosin_cortex
composites.description: E1 (extension) — a coarse 2D actomyosin cortex on the viva-lammps model seam (LammpsModelProcess + the actomyosin-cortex plugin). Contractility (LJ ε, a myosin-activity proxy) tunes the cortical tension that will map onto a Tyssue cortical-energy parameter.

n.description: Cortex patch size (lattice replications per side).

contractility.description: Myosin activity proxy (LJ well depth); higher = more cortical tension.

composites.name: closed_lumenoid
composites.description: E3 (extension) — a closed 3D lumenoid on the vivarium-tyssue engine (EulerSolver over the merged LumenoidGeometry + lumenoid mesh). Tracks a Laplace lumen pressure on top of the enclosed lumen volume and exposes the basal surface as the basement-membrane coupling shell (the surface the collagen BM attaches to).

contractility.description: Apical/basal face contractility of the lumenoid cells.

lumen_elasticity.description: Lumen pressure stiffness: P = lumen_elasticity*(V0 - V).

composites.name: tyssue_2d_sheet
composites.description: R4 — coupled 2D epithelium on the vivarium-tyssue engine: a polygonal sheet relaxed with the merged CrossSectionGeometry (explicit per-cell height DOF for the prism/height relation). The homogeneous reference for the confinement response (vs R1).

line_tension.description: Junction line tension of the 2D sheet.

composites.name: tyssue_3d_monolayer
composites.description: R5 — explicit 3D cell confinement: a Tyssue 3D monolayer (MonolayerGeometry) with apical/basal/lateral surfaces and cell-volume targets, so cell height + basal area emerge explicitly (no prism approximation).

composites.name: actin_adhesion_bm
composites.description: E2 (extension) — actin-adhesion-collagen force transfer: an actomyosin cortex (LAMMPS seam) pulls through reversible basal linkers (BasalAdhesion) on a collagen IV BM patch (CollagenNetworkProcess). Measures traction, linker occupancy and the BM deformation on a single-cell patch.

n_rods.description: Collagen rods in the single-cell BM patch.

composites.name: coupled_lumenoid
composites.description: E4 / P3 capstone — bidirectional LAMMPS collagen-BM <-> Tyssue epithelium coupling: the lumenoid's basal BM-shell surface stretches an explicit LAMMPS collagen IV BM patch, whose stress feeds back as a basal tension on the epithelium. The force round-trip the multiscale campaign is built toward (explicit-BM realization).

bm_rods.description: Collagen rods in the explicit LAMMPS BM patch.

tension_gain.description: BM stress -> added basal contractility (reaction force).

composites.name: tissue_prism_baseline
composites.description: R1 — reduced-order homogeneous tissue mechanics: a fixed-volume prism cell whose basal area is set by proliferation against a viscoelastic BM (stiffness + relaxation). Cell height = volume/area; the paper's Fig 1 confinement regimes emerge from BM stiffness vs the relaxation/doubling ratio. The effective-BM reference for R4/R5.

composites.name: turnover_shape_pipeline
composites.description: R6 — turnover->relaxation->shape inference pipeline: an inferred collagen IV lifetime (modulated by perlecan) sets the BM relaxation time, which the reduced-order prism model turns into a predicted cell shape. Inferred (relaxation) and predicted (shape) are kept distinct; conditions are control / perlecan gain-loss / growth rate.
